notes: Cover panel re-shoot of chandrama-12-laali: standing, full length, headroom for the tall crop.
prompt: Editorial fashion photograph for an Indian handloom label's festive lookbook. Tall vertical 9:16 frame.
GARMENT (a real product; match the reference photos exactly, including colours, borders and motifs):
- Saree: the rose-copper tussar tissue silk saree from the first three references, woven with copper and gold zari stripes, edged in hot pink, with a shimmering gold pallu. Luminous, crisp drape.
- Blouse: the navy-indigo silk brocade blouse with a gold floral jaal from the last two references, elbow-length sleeves, V neckline.
- The pallu spreads across the floor beside her as she kneels, showing the pink edge and gold zari.
MUSE: a woman in her early thirties with voluminous curly hair tied loosely back, a small bindi, gold earrings, focused and smiling slightly as she works.
MOMENT AND PLACE: Kojagari Lakshmi puja night: she stands in a doorway holding a small brass lamp, fresh white alpona painted on the floor at her feet, the house dim behind her.
LIGHT: The lamp's warm light on her face and the rose-copper tissue shimmering; soft darkness around.
COVER FRAMING (this photograph becomes one tall, narrow panel of the lookbook's opening page, behind a large title):
- POSE: she is standing upright, full length, head to toe in frame; ignore any seated or kneeling pose mentioned above.
- HEADROOM: the top quarter of the frame is calm, empty background (sky, wall, foliage or soft darkness); her head sits about a quarter of the way down, never near the top edge.
- Subject centred horizontally and filling the middle third of the width, so a narrow vertical crop keeps all of her.
- Keep the background simple and softly out of focus; nothing busy behind her face.
- CAMERA: eye level, 50mm lens at f/2.8, gentle depth of field, medium-format look with fine grain.
